_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative lifecycle and notification, imperative pauses and monitor
_meta.description: A payment plan for a customer's overdue invoices: PaymentPlan (header and lifecycle, the balanced-schedule guard on activate, the broken notification) and PaymentPlanInstalment (schedule, allocations per invoice). ARInvoice.paymentPlanId names the plan that covers an invoice; ReconciliationMatch.paymentPlanId names the plan a bank line paid. Pausing and resuming dunning, allocation and the daily monitor live in lib/PaymentPlan and lib/BackgroundJob/PaymentPlanMonitorJob.php.
